title: Login success with valid test credentials
description: Verify that users can log in successfully using admin / adminpassword.

steps.description: Verify redirect to /login or presence of login form
Verify redirect to a protected page (e.g. /admin, /shop, or /pos)
Verify localStorage has token or auth state

title: Redirect unauthenticated user from protected routes
description: Verify unauthenticated users are redirected to /login when accessing /pos, /shop, or /admin.

title: POS page loads and product grid is visible
description: After login as cashier/shop-admin, POS page loads and shows product grid or empty state.

steps.description: Product grid or placeholder is visible

title: Bill Manager page loads with filters
description: Bill Manager at /pos/bills loads and shows order list or empty state and filter UI.

steps.description: Filter controls or order list/empty state is visible

title: Shop Dashboard loads without HTTP 500
description: Shop dashboard and reports endpoints return 200; dashboard renders.

steps.description: Shop dashboard or first child route loads
No unhandled console errors indicating 500 from API

title: Shop Products page loads
description: Navigate to /shop/products and verify page loads.

steps.description: Products page loads (list or empty state)

title: Shop Customers page loads
description: Navigate to /shop/customers and verify page loads.

title: Authentication persists after page refresh
description: After login, refresh page and verify user remains authenticated.

steps.description: User is still on protected content, not redirected to /login
